comparisons: endpoint reliable/unknown/destination mass fractions with unknown lower/upper bounds
first contact/upward/return CDF lower and upper bounds with right-censoring
all-source residence CDF lower/upper bounds and zero-residence mass

constraints: do not modify trace outputs or old reports

interpretation_policy.material_reliability: uncalibrated; CDF agreement or support success does not establish material truth
interpretation_policy.support_unknown: numerical support failure retained in denominator; report separately
interpretation_policy.t2: not evaluated; .3 s source is a short canary, not 4.34 s qualification
interpretation_policy.residence: cumulative destination-box time within the observed 0.3 s window; all source mass is retained, reliable no-contact seeds contribute exact zero, and support-loss seeds contribute a conservative [lower, upper] interval; eventual residence after the window remains right-censored
interpretation_policy.event_cdf_bounds: finite event times are observed; unresolved permanent-unknown seeds widen only the upper CDF from the preceding committed frame, while reliable no-event seeds remain right-censored
